mainEntity.name: What is included in a whole-home interior painting service?

acceptedAnswer.text: A whole-home interior painting service typically includes preparing all interior surfaces, repairing minor imperfections, priming, and applying two coats of paint to walls, ceilings, and trim. At Frasheski Construction, our process ensures thorough preparation, which is key to a lasting finish. This includes protecting your furniture and flooring, and carefully patching small holes or cracks before painting. We aim for a comprehensive service that leaves your home looking refreshed.
